claims.claim: Q2 2026 growth is real but does not yet demonstrate self-funded commercialization: updated quarterly revenue was $13.538M while GAAP operating loss was $29.858M.

Reported Q2 operating cash generation contained a $27.4M temporary payroll-tax working-capital benefit; excluding it, management stated operating cash burn was approximately $14M and expected the tax amount to be remitted in Q3.

The updated Q2 filing increased revenue and FY2026 guidance because of a revenue-recognition timing adjustment on two government contracts, with no change to cash or underlying business assumptions; therefore the guidance uplift should not be interpreted as an equal increase in cash commercialization.

Liquidity is currently a resilience factor rather than a present blocker: the company reported $582M of cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash and available-for-sale securities and no debt at Q2, while the 10-Q states liquidity was materially increased by the February 2026 business combination and PIPE proceeds.

risks: Commercial revenue remains small relative to operating expense, so sustained technical and customer conversion is required before the business becomes self-funding.
Headline operating cash flow can overstate underlying cash economics when temporary working-capital items are not normalized.
Government-contract accounting adjustments can move reported revenue between periods without changing cash, requiring contract-level and cash corroboration.
Future capital needs are not an immediate blocker given current liquidity, but prolonged milestone slippage could convert runway into dilution risk over time.

contradictions.observed: Revenue growth and raised guidance coexist with operating losses materially above quarterly revenue.
contradictions.disposition: real commercialization-stage tension; not by itself a blocker
contradictions.falsifier: multiple periods of improving gross margin and normalized operating cash burn alongside customer-backed revenue growth would reduce this concern

contradictions.observed: The updated FY2026 revenue guidance increased while management said underlying business assumptions and cash were unchanged.
contradictions.disposition: accounting-timing explanation resolves the apparent operational acceleration claim; Alpha should separate accounting uplift from economic growth
contradictions.falsifier: incremental cash collections or contract expansion attributable to the same adjustment would show additional economic content

unknowns: Customer concentration and contract-level margin economics remain Alpha-owned underwriting inputs.
Independent verification of targeted logical-qubit milestones and customer workload economics remains outside this bounded risk assist.
Normalized post-Q3 cash burn after remittance of the payroll-tax timing item is not yet established by the cited Q2 evidence.

gatingStatus.note: Bounded risk-source support only; does not set Alpha numeric risk or score and does not adjudicate resolver-owned contradiction state.
